Job Description

Ready to leverage your innovative expertise to drive the transition from traditional cloud to autonomous AI platforms? Are you ambitious, equipped with razor-sharp analytical skills, and eager to build the indispensable foundation that our AI and data teams depend on? Do you thrive when given a high degree of autonomy? If so, we are looking for you!

Your Contribution to the Adventure

The rise of AI coding tools is changing the software world at breakneck speed: writing code is becoming cheaper and faster, leading to exponential growth in the volume of code we produce. However, more code also means a larger test surface. To prevent our development velocity from stalling over the question, "can we confidently deploy this to production?", we need you. You will become the owner of our automated testing platform and CI infrastructure, ensuring our teams can continue to release at maximum speed.

What does this entail?

System & Architecture: This is not a role where you will simply click through test cases or manually verify code. Your output is the system and the architecture behind the tests. You will design the test framework, manage the test data lifecycle, and build a stable, cross-team smoke suite that spans our markets in NL, BE, DK, and DE.
Tech-Lead & Coaching: Additionally, you are a true tech-lead and sparring partner. You will coach and support teams in writing their own local E2E tests within your platform.
Execution & Communication: You are driven by execution and communication: you collaborate seamlessly with colleagues like Joke and Pasha to translate their exploratory testing insights into rock-solid automated regression coverage.
Autonomous Future: In doing so, you calibrate the confidence within our transition toward fully autonomous product development.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders: 

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”

Who is 12Build?

With a healthy dose of Drive, Openness and Happiness, we are building a transparent construction sector. We are not only a SaaS platform that connects construction companies and promotes collaboration, we are also the market leader in the Netherlands. We have been around for almost twenty years and we are still growing. Our team now consists of more than 90 colleagues, working together from two offices and various home offices throughout Europe. A large part of the construction world in the Benelux, Germany and Denmark already works on our platform and uses our software on a daily basis. And we have the ambition to conquer the whole of Europe!

Our Stack & Tools

Within our development team, we are continuously expanding and improving our own SaaS platform. We work with, among other things:

Testing & CI Infrastructure: E2E test frameworks, CI/CD test gates, Test data lifecycles, Docker, Terraform. 
Core Cloud Services: AWS, SNS, SQS, S3, Lambda, and API Gateway. 
Development & Data: PHP (Laravel), Vue.js ( Nuxt.js ), TypeScript, JavaScript, MySQL, and OpenSearch. 
Collaboration & AI Tools: Claude, Linear, Confluence, and Slack.

An organized, methodical, and flexible team player with a clear vision for test automation. 
Someone with strong interpersonal and communication skills who actively seeks connection with product teams and other QA colleagues. 
A proactive, hands-on leader ("meewerkend voorman") with an independent work ethic, who isn't afraid to dive deep into 'flake discipline' to tackle testing issues at their root. 
A strong driving force who tightly structures and safeguards the CI testing phases. 
Analytically minded, eager to learn, and always up-to-date with the latest methodologies (such as LLM-as-a-judge frameworks). 
Proven experience in software development or software testing, with a track record of setting up robust test platform architectures.

A starting salary between €5,500 and €6,500 gross per month (based on a senior job level).
A 'Lease a Bike' scheme with a €10 monthly employer contribution.
A home office allowance for the days you work from home.

An exciting role within a growing, international SaaS scale-up.
Flexible work options (hybrid setup: both from home and the office).
Regular team events and ample opportunities for personal and professional development.
Choose your own hardware: Windows, Mac, or Linux—everything is possible.
Working in an organisation where culture really is number one. Read here how we do that.
No towering hierarchical layers. Just a flat organisation with short lines of communication, which makes things easy.

You build .NET/C# services that connect large batteries, rooftop solar and other customer-side assets to our Virtual Power Plant.
You make quality part of how features get built: automated integration and E2E tests, plus load and performance testing for a system that runs 24/7 in live energy markets.
You help the team work smarter with AI-assisted development, from test generation to debugging.

Why choose Eneco?

At Eneco we work towards one clear goal: being climate-neutral by 2035. A big part of that is flexibility, using renewable energy at the right moment. Our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) links many energy sources and steers them centrally as one portfolio.

More and more of that flexibility sits "behind the meter", at our customers' sites: large batteries, solar panels and other installations. Your services make it possible for these smaller assets to join the market together. That means more green energy used well, and less need for fossil backup. You do this in a team that takes engineering seriously, shares what it learns, and gives you room to grow as a technical leader.

What You’ll Do

You build and maintain backend services and integrations in .NET/C#.
You develop solutions that optimise behind-the-meter assets and connect data flows so smaller assets can trade as part of Eneco's pool.
You design and maintain automated integration and end-to-end tests, so the team can trust every release of our services and integrations.
You run load and performance tests to find bottlenecks, scalability risks and reliability issues before they reach production.
You keep improving test automation, test coverage and feedback cycles, so developers know quickly when something breaks.
You build quality into features from the start, instead of testing them afterwards.
You use AI tools across your work, including test generation, refactoring and debugging, and review the output critically.
You drive Proofs of Concept and work with architects on system design.
You mentor medior and junior engineers through code reviews and technical guidance.
You share on-call duty for a system that runs 24/7.

Is this about you?

You have around 7 years of backend experience in .NET/C# and have built complex, high-availability distributed systems.
You know event-driven architecture and async messaging, for example Kafka, Azure Event Hubs or RabbitMQ.
You're comfortable with Azure, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, microservices, and both relational and non-relational data.
You have a strong Quality Engineering mindset: to you, quality, testability and automation are part of building software.
You have practical experience with automated integration and E2E testing.
You've done load and performance testing and know how to investigate performance and scalability risks.
You're a software engineer first. You enjoy building features and the tests that prove they work, rather than focusing on test automation alone.
You use AI-assisted development tools in your daily work, check their output critically, and like sharing what works with your team.
You're happy to take on-call responsibility, live in the Netherlands and speak English fluently.
Knowledge of energy markets, optimisation or aggregation platforms is a plus. Don't have it yet? You'll learn the domain here.
Recognise yourself in most of this, but not every requirement? We'd still love to hear from you.

You’ll be responsible for

Reliable, scalable services that connect distributed assets to our VPP and keep running 24/7.
Quality built into the development lifecycle through automated testing.
New features and services that ship with the right integration and E2E test coverage.
Performance and scalability, backed by load and performance testing.
Faster, more reliable feedback for the team through more automation.
Technical ownership of your components, including tackling technical debt and reliability risks early.
AI-assisted work that meets the same bar for security, quality and maintainability as anything else.
A stronger team through reviews, mentoring and shared standards.

This is where you’ll work

You join an engineering team working on the platforms behind our Virtual Power Plant. You work closely with fellow engineers, architects and colleagues from other disciplines. We review each other's code, share what we learn, and explore AI and automation together, so you get plenty of room to bring in your own ideas.

What We Have To Offer

Gross annual salary between €80,000 and €120,000 Including FlexBudget, 8% holiday allowance, and depending on your role a bonus or collective profit sharing.
FlexBudget Have it paid out, use it to buy extra holiday days or save it up for something nice, it's up to you.
Personal and professional growth Eneco is fully committed to help you in your personal and professional development.
Hybrid working: home, office or abroad Work 40% at the office, 40% from home, and 20% flexibly. With manager approval, you may work abroad (within approved countries) up to 3 weeks/year, max 2 consecutively.

Work Where Everyone Matters 

When you choose a career at Eneco, you choose ambition, growth, and opportunity in an environment where everyone matters. You’re given the space to develop yourself and to do your work in a way that suits you. We believe that different perspectives, nationalities, and backgrounds make us stronger, which is why we foster an open, safe and inclusive culture. Naturally, we also prioritize a healthy work-life balance, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home when your role allows it. If you have a physical or sensory disability, we will work with you to find the right adjustments so you can perform your job well.

This is how you build your own future and a sustainable future at the same time. Together with 4,000 colleagues, each with their own talents and ideas, you work on our shared mission: speeding up the energy transition. We help customers become more sustainable faster, create innovative solutions, and seize new opportunities. Will you join us?
